title.en: Which Tiny Original Superpower Would You Pick?
title.zh: 只在小事里有用：你会选哪种原创微能力？

description.en: Choose an original low-stakes power for six fictional scenes: finding a missing word, placing a tiny pause or revealing a useful edge.
description.zh: 为六个虚构小场景选原创微能力：找到漏词、放入短暂停顿或显出有用边缘。

introduction.en: All powers and characters are original inventions. Nothing here measures a real ability or grants control over another person. Each power has a small limit, and none solves a serious real-world problem.
introduction.zh: 能力与角色均原创虚构。不测真实能力，也不授予控制别人。每能力有限制，不解决严肃现实问题。

focus.en: Preferring a fictional power that clarifies a phrase, makes room for a voluntary pause or makes a small physical detail visible.
focus.zh: 选能澄清短句、留自愿停顿或让实体小细节可见的虚构能力。

prompt.en: Your tiny power can do one thing. You choose…

label.en: Suggest one missing ordinary word in a fictional label.
label.zh: 为虚构标签提一个漏掉的普通词。

label.en: Place a short optional pause inside an imaginary scene.
label.zh: 给想象场景放一个可选短停顿。

label.en: Outline one small overlooked edge on an invented object.
label.zh: 勾出虚构物一处忽略的小边。

prompt.en: A paper exhibition feels confusing. You use…

label.en: A place where a character can stop looking for a moment.
label.zh: 一处角色可暂时不看的停点。

label.en: A visible outline separating two overlapping props.
label.zh: 可见边线，分开相叠两道具。

label.en: One plain word that makes a label less vague.
label.zh: 一个普通词，让标签不含糊。

prompt.en: Your power must have a limit. It cannot…
prompt.zh: 能力必须有限制，它不能……

label.en: Show anything that is not already drawn in the fiction.
label.zh: 显出虚构画里原本没有的东西。

label.en: Know what another character secretly thinks.
label.zh: 知道另一角色暗中想什么。

label.en: Stop time or force anyone to remain still.

prompt.en: You use the power for a small creative task by…

label.en: Finding a plainer caption for one invented image.
label.zh: 给一张虚构图找更普通图注。

label.en: Giving the maker a chance to choose whether to continue.
label.zh: 给作者自选是否继续的机会。

label.en: Making the join between two paper shapes visible.

prompt.en: Another character declines the offer. You…

label.en: Let them continue without adding a pause.

prompt.en: The tiny power’s motto would be…

label.en: Notice the little edge already there.
One plain word can be enough.
A moment can stay available to choose.

title.zh: 补一个普通词的微能力

summary.en: Your original power makes one small phrase easier to understand. It does not read minds or discover a hidden truth; it offers a possible word that a fictional writer can accept or decline.
summary.zh: 你的原创能力让一小句更好懂。不读心或揭隐藏真相，只给虚构作者可接可拒的词。

example.en: A vague label saying “put it there” might gain the word “shelf,” making the small imagined instruction easier to follow.
example.zh: “放那儿”的模糊标签可补“架子”，让小想象指引好跟。

strength.en: A tiny language adjustment gives this fictional power a bounded use and makes an ordinary communication detail worth noticing without grand claims.
strength.zh: 小文字调整给能力有界用途，让普通沟通细节值得看，不做大主张。

tradeoff.en: Even a clearer word can be the wrong word for someone else. The character keeps authorship and does not have to accept the suggestion.
tradeoff.zh: 更清词对别人也可错。角色保有作者权，不必接受建议。

experiment.en: Invent a vague fictional label and two possible clarifying words. Explain how each changes the instruction without declaring one universally correct.
experiment.zh: 编模糊虚构标签与两种澄清词，写各怎样改指令，不宣称一种普遍正确。

title.zh: 放一个可选停顿的微能力

summary.en: Your power makes a moment available rather than taking control of time. A fictional character can use the pause, skip it or choose a different next step.
summary.zh: 你的能力让片刻可用，不控制时间。虚构角色可用、跳过或选别的下一步。

example.en: In an imaginary paper parade, a small marked space might let one character stop to look while the rest of the scene continues.
example.zh: 想象纸游行里，一小标记位置让角色停看，其余场景继续。

strength.en: An optional pause can give a busy little scene another possible rhythm without requiring every participant to slow down together.
strength.zh: 可选停点给忙碌小景另一节奏，不要求所有人一起慢。

tradeoff.en: A pause is not automatically helpful and cannot solve a serious problem in this game. The character’s choice gives the power its limit.
tradeoff.zh: 暂停不自动有用，也不解决严肃问题。角色选择就是能力边界。

experiment.en: Write a short fictional scene with an optional stopping point. Give the character two equally valid continuations, including one that does not use it.
experiment.zh: 写带可选停点的短虚构景，给角色两种同样有效继续法，一种不用停点。

title.zh: 显出原有边缘的微能力

summary.en: Your power makes one existing detail easier to see in a fictional image. It changes visibility, not the object’s value or the character’s real capacity to understand the world.
summary.zh: 你的能力让虚构图中已有细节更可见。它改可见度，不改物价值或角色理解世界的真能力。

example.en: A light outline around two overlapping paper pieces might reveal that the smaller piece is a separate removable tab.
example.zh: 叠纸处轻勾边，可显较小片是独立可取标签。

strength.en: A bounded visual cue gives the story a concrete tiny discovery and lets an ordinary construction become interesting without a dramatic secret.
strength.zh: 有界视觉提示给故事具体小发现，让普通结构有趣，不需大秘密。

tradeoff.en: An outline can direct attention away from other details. The fictional viewer may choose to remove it and look at the whole picture again.
tradeoff.zh: 勾边也会移开别处注意。虚构观者可撤边，再看全图。

experiment.en: Draw two overlapping harmless shapes and imagine highlighting only one edge. Describe what becomes clearer and what remains unchanged in the drawing.
experiment.zh: 画两无害相叠形，想象只亮一边，描述什么更清、图中什么未变。
